commit.message: fix(cell): read original Training completion from full iteration snapshots

pull_request.body:
## Why

Restore passes the current full iteration snapshot to original stage owners. The typed Q24 Training stage requires its exact Dataset cut. Without reconstructing that original cut, a completed or intermediate history cannot read its original Training receipt through this boundary.

## Changes

- Validate the complete snapshot with the existing Coordinator before extracting its Dataset prefix.
- Replay receipts at their original observation times; require a Training expected receipt and a legal historical extension.
- Compare retained Training, expected Training and the actual original owner completion in every field.
- Delegate exactly once to the original typed stage readback. Preserve the existing non-queuing lane, Dataset/scope binding, both original CURRENT checks and signed-evidence expiry checks.
- Allow Dataset-only lost-ACK readback only when the original owner has a retained completion. Missing/Pending does not fit, claim, first-attest, sign or renew.
- Add five Rust behavior cases and source-boundary mutation checks; register the one new helper-to-stage readback caller.

The production module is 74 lines. The original stage, native owner, receipt owner, six existing stage tests and caller verifier are unchanged.

## Fixed identity

- Published source: `be8adcbb5e9925f72e05330b8fb30509cba4544b`
- Tree: `eaa8b27f16a5f9fed87e9d6882cd23dfaecfd125`
- Parent / target candidate: `30a697c50e10abd56e61b6b84f28ac9ae9f32f5d`
- Independently reviewed local equivalent: `8ad9f24e238b0680f975fea8c9d26db146066a8c`, exact same tree.
- This draft targets the P0 candidate branch from #5865, preserving its current full-repository CI run while the component gets its own exact-source qualification.

## Validation

- Scoped `just fmt --base 30a697c…` and `git diff --check`: PASS on the reviewed identical tree.
- Nine source-closure unit cases: PASS.
- Complete protected/inventory configuration check: 224 boundaries, 224 inventory records, 219 protected records; all authority values false.
- Independent fixed-source review: no blocking issue found.
- Fresh complete caller scan on the published source: in progress.
- The five new Rust cases and the six unchanged Training-stage cases still require this source's native CI; no local native build was started under the existing resource constraint.

The five new cases cover real native Candidate/NoUpdate fixtures, Dataset-only lost ACK, intermediate/full histories, owner reopen, structurally valid receipt replacement, invalid/foreign cuts, Missing/Pending, request deadline versus signature expiry, two CURRENT changes, and unchanged bytes of the four original files. Later-stage histories are explicitly structural fixtures.

## Scope limits

This component authenticates Training only. Its caller must supply original checkpoint CURRENT custody and authenticate other stages. It does not create a complete `LearningIterationStageOwnerPortsV1`, wire Root startup, provision file/key/trust custody, define Dataset extraction semantics, or admit native SGD candidates through the governed proposal protocol.

The new helper itself has no ordinary product caller yet; constructor/execute/attestation and Root assembly remain fail-closed. Ordinary complete Adopt and correct NoUpdate runs both remain **0**. Historical `30a` or earlier CI results are not transferred to this new source.
